items.text: Teofilo eigerokoki ena buku
Ore te nkaraki natii lkumok ootonyuaakita aaiger imbaa naatupukutuo ti atua iyiook,
neigero anaa enainosakaki iyiook lelo apa ootoduaa te nkiterunoto too nkonyek enye, oora ninche laisiaayiak ooinosu ele rorei le Nkai.
Nadol sii nanu, Oloyanyiti Teofilo, ajo keishiaakino, natisipua mbaa pooki te rishata naado, naaigeroki mbaa naaitobirakino aitisipaki,
pee itum atayiolo esipata e kuna baa nikinosakaki.
Etolimuoki einoto e Yohana Olaibatisani
Etii apa te nkata o laiguanani Herode, le Yudea, olapolosani oji Sakaria, lo lkekun le Abija; ore enkitok enye naa ene ntalipa e Aaron, neji enkarna enye Elisabet.
Naa supati ninche pokira are ti alo Enkai, nesuj inkitanapat o nkitoriat pooki o Laitoriani, meitong'or.
Nemeeta enkerai, amu koolupi Elisabet, naa moruak pokira are.
Neaku ore eitayu Sakaria esiaai e mpolosare too nkatitin olkekun lenye te dukuya Enkai,
anaa enaikununo olokishoni loo lapolosak, nedoiki enkukuo metaa ninye ojing enkaji o Laitoriani, ainok olasar le nkorropil.
Neomon olorora te boo, ina kata einoki enkorropil.
Neipang'aki olmalaika lo Laitoriani aitashe te nkalo e tatene olperere lo lasar le nkorropil.
Ore pee edol Sakaria neirut,
nejoki olmalaika, “Sakaria, miureishoyu, etoning'oki enkomono ino: naa aikiiki enkitok ino Elisabet enkayioni, naa eimpot enkarna enye ajo Yohana.
Naa itum iyie enchipai o eng'ida to ltau lino, neng'ida ltung'ana kumok te inoto enye.
Enki 6.3
Amu eaku ninye kitok te dukuya Olaitoriani, nemeok enaisho oo sabibu arashu enaisho napi, naa keigany Enkiyang'et Sinyati ebaiki etii enkoshoke e ng'otonye.
Naa kerrinyoki Siraeli kumok Olaitoriani Enkai enye,

neituruk dukuya ninye aaku olkilikuai lenye, te nkiyang'et o te ngolon e Eliya, eitaiki osotua enkerai o menye, neibelekeny iloogol onyek menoto eng'eno e lelo supati pee eitobiraki Olaitoriani iltung'ana ooishiaakino.”
Nejoki Sakaria olmalaika, “Ainyoo ayiolounye ena bae? Nataa moruo, naa moruo sii ninye enkitok ai?”
Dan 8.16
Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Ara nanu Gabriel, oitashe te dukuya Enkai; naairriwuaki maairorie naaitabaiki ele kilikuai supat.
Ng'ura kionyo enkutuk mintoki airo, o metabau ina olong naibalayu nena, amu eitu iruk irorei laainei, kake eitabari ake te nkata naikenakaki.”
Naa keanyita ake lekua tung'ana Sakaria neing'asia te nkimutioto naimutie ti atua Enkaji e Nkai.
Ore pee epuku, neitu eidim airorie ninche, neyiolou ninche aajo eeta enatoduaa te neinokieki olasar. Neitodol too lmonek meidim airorie.
Ore pee eidipayu ilkekuno le nkisiayiare enye, nelo ang.
Ore pee elusoo nena olong'i, neiroshiu enkitok enye Elisabet, neisudoo kewan ilapaitin imiet, ejo,
“Ena aaitaasa Olaitoriani te nkata natoduaa naaoru esulare te dukuya iltung'ana.”
Etolimuoki einoto e Yesu
Ore to lapa le ile, neirriwaa Enkai olmalaika oji Gabriel, meshomo enkang e Galilaya naji Nasaret,
Mat 1.18
enetii eselenkei natisira oltung'ani oji Yosef, lo lgilata le Daudi; naa keji ina selenkei Mariamu.
Nejing'aki nejoki, “Takuenya na kirotet! Etii Olaitoriani te nebo iyie!”
Neirut oleng te nkaraki lelo rorei, nejo to ltau, “Kaji eikununo ena kirorokino?”
Nejoki olmalaika, “Mariamu, miureishoyu, itaa kirotet te Nkai.
Mat 1.21
Naa ing'ura inutayu, niiu enkayioni, nimpot enkarna enye ajo Yesu.
Isa 9.7
Naa keaku kitok neji Oinoti lo Lotii Shumata Aisul te pooki naa keisho Olaitoriani Enkai ninye olorika le nkitoo le Daudi menye lenye,
neitore olgilata le Yakobo intarasi, nemeiting enkitoria enye.”
Nejoki Mariamu ilo malaika, “Kaji eiko pee eaku ena nemayiolo olee?”
Newaliki olmalaika ajoki, “Elotu Enkiyang'et Sinyati shumata iyie, nikintoip engolon o Lotii Shumata Aisul, ore te nkaraki ina, ore enkerai naini, neji sinyati, Enkerai e Nkai.
Naa ing'ura, ore enkanashe ino Elisabet nenuta te moruo enye, naa keiu enkayioni, naa ole ile ele apa, te nutai enye, enatejoki oshi koolupi.
Amu meetae embae nemeidimayu te Nkai.”
Nejo Mariamu, “Kara nanu esinka o Laitoriani; metotiwuo te nanu anaa enitejo.” Nelo olmalaika aing'uaa ninye.
Eshomo Mariamu abaiki Elisabet
Ore te nena olong'i, nedumunye Mariamu aisarrisar alo enkop oo oldoinyo, enkanasa e Yuda,
nejing enkaji e Sakaria, neiroroki Elisabet.
Ore ake pee ening Elisabet enkirorokino e Mariamu, neipid enkerai te nkoshoke; neigany Elisabet Enkiyang'et Sinyati,
nebuak to ltoilo sapuk ajo, “Kitamayianaki iyie too nkituaak, nemayiani eishoi e ng'uset ino!
Kaji eikununo ele rorei, eji ng'otonye Olaitoriani lai nalotu enatii?
Amu ore ake pee aning too nkiyiaa aainei enkiroroto ino, neipid enkerai te nchipai te nkoshoke ai.
Emayiana enairuko inchere keitabari inaatiaakaki ninye eing'uaa Olaitoriani.”
Mariamu nataranya ele sinkolio te nchipai
Nejo Mariamu,
Einoto e Yohana Olaibatisani
Nebau enkata neisho Elisabet, neiu enkayioni.
Nening elatia enye, o lgilata lenye nchere, eing'urrie Olaitoriani, neshipayu te nebo ninye.
Ilaw 12.3
Ore te nkolong e isiet, nepuonu aa murat enkerai, neyieu nedung'oki enkarna aaipotie Sakaria menye lenye.
Nejoki, ng'otonye, “Mme neijia, keipoti aajo, Yohana.”
Nejokini, “Meetae oltung'ani lo lmarei linyi oji neijia.”
Neikilikuan menye too lmonek enayieu neji.
Neipotu osoit dapash neiger ajo, “Keji enkarna Yohana!” Neingasia pooki.
Nebolo Sakaria enkutuk ina kata ake, nelaa olng'ejep lenye, neiro, aisis Enkai.
Neureishoyu pooki oomanya ina latia, nelikiori nena baa pooki to ldoinyo le Yudea.
Ore lootoning'o pooki neiteng'el too ltauja lenye ejo, “Keaku pasa ena kerai keniaa pukunoto?” Amu eiriamunore enkaina e Nkai ninye.
Mbaa kuna naatolimuo Sakaria
Neiput Sakaria, menye lenye Enkiyang'et Sinyati neibonisho ajo,
Nebulu enkerai, neponari engolon e nkiyang'et, nebik ti ong'ata o metabau enkolong naipang'akinyeki olorere le Israel.
